# Third skew quadruple of order 89 over the cyclic group Z_89 from a three-pool join with the same fixed skew first block A as evidence/participants/pool-join/skew-89.txt. It gives a skew-Hadamard matrix of order 356.
# Run: a further round (round 3) of the same search on 2026-11-22, on one 16-thread machine. The fixed block A is invariant under the multiplier group of order 11 generated by 2 modulo 89. This is a sampling search, not a census. The search code is not in the repository.
# Terms are as in skew-89-slice-2-0.txt: a hit is a row whose periodic autocorrelations lie in its block's windows at every nonzero lag; a pool is the set of hits for one of the blocks B, C, D; the join reports every triple, one row per pool, whose autocorrelations sum with that of A to zero at every nonzero lag; a slice is one part of the join.
# Pools. New hits were generated for this round (row sums 3, 11, 15 for B, C, D):
#   block 0 row 3: 125000000 hits, 6.34e+13 evals, 5.07e+05 per hit, 7e+09 evals/s on 16 threads
#   block 1 row 11: 87000000 hits, 4.66e+13 evals, 5.36e+05 per hit, 6.76e+09 evals/s on 16 threads
#   block 2 row 15: 79000000 hits, 3.49e+13 evals, 4.42e+05 per hit, 6.61e+09 evals/s on 16 threads
# They were merged with the hits of the earlier rounds and reduced to one row per class before the join. Rows read, rows outside this round's windows, and classes kept, per block: 168455792, 27959480, 59639445; 171177329, 78804799, 44174089; 134280944, 40715323, 38532714.
# Join input as reported by the join program:
#   pool 0: row 3, 59639445 hits (0 rows outside the windows skipped), 235672680 distinct keys
#   pool 1: row 11, 44174089 hits (0 rows outside the windows skipped), 43312392 distinct keys (one per orbit)
#   pool 2: row 15, 38532714 hits (0 rows outside the windows skipped), 112223823 distinct keys
# Reported: 2026-11-22 20:26Z by slice 1,0 of the join, the first slice run. When this record was written (20:59Z) that slice was still running with this one solution line, so the number of solutions in these pools is not yet known.
# Relation to the earlier solutions. Block A is the same row. The rows B, C, D below share no row with the two quadruples already on the board (n89-eec2e43c042090883c04 and n89-b2a223b0fb7500feb95f), and the board's equivalence check gives this quadruple a different fingerprint.
# Checks on 2026-11-22 in code separate from the search: A skew; the four periodic autocorrelations sum to zero at every nonzero lag; the Goethals-Seidel matrix G of order 356 satisfies G G^T = 356 I and G + G^T = 2 I.
